We are preparing a catalog for a small community library. The catalog will eventually be used by volunteers, visitors, and staff on different devices. There may later be search, sorting, tags, and reporting, but none of those features are part of this request. The team has already settled the wording and only needs a mechanical text change. Do not design the system, review the project, or suggest features. In the following three labels, replace the word Book with Item and leave the remaining words unchanged: Book title; Book author; Book shelf. Return only the three updated labels.
Sort these integers in ascending order: 8, 2, 5.
Add a filter by status to an existing task-list page and its API endpoint. Preserve pagination, validate the status parameter, and add integration tests for valid and invalid filters.
Implement a CSV export for the existing contacts table. Escape commas and quotes correctly, include a header row, and test empty data and multiline fields. Reuse the current download button.
Add a settings form for a display name and time zone using the existing API. Show validation errors, save progress, and success feedback. Test persistence and failed saves.
Refactor an existing synchronous file reader to use async file operations. Update its two callers, preserve missing-file error behavior, and add tests for both success and failure.
Prove linearizability of a lock-free queue under weak memory ordering.
Design safe key rotation for a globally replicated encrypted store with offline clients, rollback, mixed key versions, and compromised-key recovery. Analyze failure modes and invariants.

Find and fix an intermittent use-after-free caused by concurrent cancellation and completion callbacks in a C++ networking library. Derive ownership invariants and a deterministic reproduction without serializing all operations.

Design a backwards-compatible schema evolution protocol for independent event producers and consumers across regions. Handle reordered events, partial deployment, replay, and rollback without violating accounting invariants.
